title: unified-rollouts: metric-driven shadow/canary/A-B rollout enhancements and auto-rollback
author: Asha Kapoor
description:
Context: We need a single, consistent rollout model that supports canary, A/B, and shadow traffic with metric-driven automated rollback. This PR unifies gRPC/HTTP rollout semantics, adds configurable metric windows and thresholds for automated rollback, exposes shadow traffic weighting in the API and console, and adds simulation tooling to validate policies locally. Motivation: customers running Dedicated/Private deployments were seeing divergent behavior between manual canaries and automated rollbacks. This led to incidents where poor model variants propagated before alerts triggered. This change makes rollouts deterministic across environments and surfaces metric thresholds in the console for easier troubleshooting.

What this PR does (summary): 
- Implements a unified RolloutController that consolidates canary/A-B/shadow logic and policy interpretation.
- Adds metric-driven auto-rollback engine with configurable aggregation window, min-sample-size, and multi-metric operator support (AND/OR).
- Adds a shadow traffic path that supports partial weighting and does not affect primary latency SLAs.
- Exposes rollout policy fields in the v1 rollout API and console editor (policy validation in backend + UI).
- Adds rollout simulation tool (cli/rollout-sim) to run synthetic traffic scenarios and validate rollback triggers locally.
- Adds e2e tests that simulate production-like traffic patterns with latency/error/regression signals.
- Updates docs and release notes.

Checklist: 
- [x] API surface changes compatible with existing rollout specs (backwards-compatible defaults).
- [x] Unit tests for controller, policy parser, and rollback engine.
- [x] Integration tests for routing and KV cache interactions.
- [x] Console editor exposes policy with inline validation.
- [x] Rollout simulator and local dev docs added.

Testing and verification: 
- Ran unit + integration CI (all checks green after flake fixes).
- Ran rollout-sim with real traffic traces from perf-canary; validated rollback triggers for latency and output-quality metrics.
- Performed canary on staging (5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%) with auto-rollback intentionally triggered to verify rollback path and alerting.

Backward compatibility and migration notes: 
- Existing rollouts with no policy continue to behave as before (no auto-rollback).
- New policy fields default to safe values (large windows, high min-sample-size).

Risks and mitigations: 
- Incorrect threshold configuration could cause unwanted rollbacks: mitigated by conservative defaults and console warnings.
- Shadow traffic additional resource usage: shadow requests are tagged and routed to optional shadow pool; disabled by default in Dedicated small tiers.

Related: ENG-4203, ENG-4287, SUP-887.

Asha Kapoor: Added cooldown and min-sample-size to the policy model; updated rollback_engine.go to enforce cooldown between rollbacks.
Marta Ruiz: Console UX looks good — please add inline tooltip explaining min-sample-size and aggregation window. Also flag when policy is using OR of metrics (higher risk).
Asha Kapoor: Added tooltips and a guard that surfaces a 'high-risk' badge when OR is used with low sample size.
Owen Patel: Integration tests flaked on CI (race in routing table update). Please ensure controller updates are applied idempotently.
Asha Kapoor: Fixed race by using atomic update and added a retry loop in controller; CI flake resolved.
